purpose: Check whether an official article correction, supplement, or repository notice resolves the Agno survey's wet/dry month mapping and station locality inconsistencies; prepare, but do not send, a focused author inquiry.

questions.universityOfGlasgowRecord: The current data-collection description maps wet season to January 2022 and dry season to July 2021.
questions.datasetReadme: Also maps wet to January 2022 and dry to July 2021, although it has its own incorrect dry-season filename/date description.
questions.articleMethods: Section 2.2 says fish/water sampling took place in July and January, respectively, during the wet and dry seasons, mapping July to wet and January to dry.
questions.matrix: Fish_count.csv has only Wet/Dry season labels and no date per count cell.
questions.disposition: No exact date may be assigned to a fish-count season until an author or formal primary correction resolves the conflict.

questions.mapScreens: Both the DPWH service derived from a NAMRIA source and one Nominatim reverse-geocoder result place the point in San Nicolas, Pangasinan. Neither is treated as authoritative station identity or legal boundary evidence.
questions.disposition: Do not relocate the station, assign a different municipality, or attach it to a specific reach without author/primary-source clarification.
Keep both source spellings. A municipality-level point screen does not establish whether they denote the exact same named station.

searchAndAccess.officialRepositoryRecord: University of Glasgow dataset page reviewed; it retains the January-wet/July-dry mapping and the two CC BY 4.0 data/README files. No correction notice or additional data file is linked in the reviewed record. The record provides a 'Request a correction' link; it was not followed or submitted.
searchAndAccess.articleRepositoryRecord: University of Glasgow article record and repository-hosted full text reviewed. The abstract gives July 2021 and January 2022 without a season mapping; section 2.2 supplies the conflicting July-wet/January-dry mapping. The full text has no supplementary-information reference found by text search.
searchAndAccess.publisherSearch: Exact DOI/title web searches did not locate a correction or corrigendum. Direct DOI landing-page access was unavailable in this review, so this is a bounded search rather than proof that no publisher notice exists.
searchAndAccess.contact: The article identifies K. F. C. Tenio as corresponding author and prints kitfelian.tenio@vsu.edu.ph. This is recorded only to prepare a manual draft; no email, correction form or message was sent.

nextAction: Joseph may review and send the draft to the publicly listed corresponding-author address or use the repository correction link. Continue independent freshwater source acquisition while the source conflicts remain held.
